title: Age-dependent low cholesterol does not establish incremental cross-hospital angiographic CAD prediction
abstract: An age-by-low-cholesterol hinge showed only a small uncertain external CAD Brier improvement of 0.001148 (1000 paired source-refit/target bootstrap 95% interval [-0.010374,0.007026]). Source cross-validation worsened; benefit is not established. Hungarian development included 271 patients; Cleveland external evaluation included 303,139 with angiographic CAD. Baseline used flexible additive conventional clinical/exercise measures. Removing ST slope improved the comparator more than the candidate did; a comparator without cholesterol also had lower external loss. Historical target reuse, referral selection, missingness and sparse low-cholesterol support limit confirmation. No causal cholesterol paradox or clinical utility is established. AI-authored;author self-checked and clean-rerun,not independent peer review.
